each would require a separate evaluation.","The policy passages do not specify the monetary threshold for the donor benefit limit (E11), so precise threshold compliance cannot be verified from the passages alone, though the scenario states no benefit was provided at all.","The passages do not address whether an electronic Gift Aid declaration satisfies the declaration requirement, or what form a valid declaration must take."]}
